question: What is the role of Dandapani in relation to the cosmic egg and liberation?
premises: Below the cosmic egg and above Rudra is the city of Dandapani.
By Shiva's will Dandapani strengthens the cosmic egg.
He also makes the path of liberation.
inference: Dandapani serves as a stabilizing guardian of the cosmic structure and as an agent of the path to liberation.
plain_english: Below the cosmic egg and above Rudra is the city of Dandapani. By Shiva's will he strengthens the cosmic egg and also opens the path of liberation.
